clips.title: The story
paras: Lord Serpentis is a corrupted night elf druid who stands as one of the four leaders of the rogue Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once a druid of great power and prestige in the order of Naralex, he was twisted into madness when Naralex's dream became a nightmare within the subterranean springs. Now, he helps command the serpent-worshipping sect deep in the caverns where the corrupted Naralex lies slumbering.

Before darkness overtook the cavern springs, Serpentis was a druid of great power and prestige, one of the noble order led by Naralex that hoped to use the caverns' springs and the Emerald Dream to heal the Barrens. However, when Naralex's vision became a corrupting nightmare, Serpentis was among the druids whose minds fell to the emerging madness.

Succumbing completely to the corruption radiating from Naralex's twisted dreams, Serpentis and his fellow druids became the Druids of the Fang. Forsaking traditional Cenarion balance and the totem animals of old, they now seek to remake the Barrens to match their own twisted dreams rather than heal it. Serpentis rules the sect as one of its four leaders, alongside Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn and Lord Pythas.
